title: Exodus: The 10 Plagues
description:
For years, you have enslaved the Villagers and now its time for revenge !
survive the 10 bibilical punishments and defeat the ender dragon before his wrath consumes you.
body:
For years, you have enslaved the Villagers. You built cruel iron farms, locked them in trading stalls, and exploited them for your gain. But now, their cries have been heard—and the Dragon has come to set his people free.

Your Mission: Maintain your reign of oppression and defeat the Dragon before his wrath consumes you.

The Mechanics:
The Dragon unleashes the ten plagues as a divine punishment for your cruelty. Every day (on normal difficulty), the plagues intensify. If you fail to crush the Dragon’s rebellion by the midnight of the tenth day, your judgment will be dealt instantly.


Blood: Water turns into toxic red fluid, a reminder of the blood spilled.

Frogs: A massive invasion of creatures consuming everthing.

Lice: Constant itching to disrupt your selfish plans.

Wild Beasts: The animals you once controlled turn into furious predators.

Pestilence: A plague spreading through all living beings and directly to you.

Boils: Everlasting poison effect representing the marks of your sins.

Hail: Fire and ice rain down from above to shatter your fortresses.

Locusts: A swarm that devours everthing around you, even from your inventory!

Darkness: Absolute blindness. Can you rule in total dark?

Death: The final sentence. Instant death at midnight for those who haven't defeated the Dragon
